integrity: Self-contained proof and reproducible finite checks; scientific originality and significance assessed provisionally; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the three-block unipotent radical of block dimensions (2m,m,2m) is treated; q is fixed during the limit.
The finite rank-stratum formula follows from standard rank enumeration; it is not proposed as a new general rank-counting identity.
Asymptotic errors have constants depending on q. Individual conjugacy classes and other block ratios are not classified.
The related prior literature may contain an equivalent specialization or a stronger weighted-rank asymptotic; historical novelty is not certified.
title: A theta law and its first correction for three-block unipotent commutativity
